svg.title: Unit circle in the complex plane: the real equality case of Cauchy-Schwarz is the two points plus one and minus one, while over the complex field equality holds on the entire unit circle, with the counterexample i marked

g.text: Re c
Im c
equality over the complex field: the WHOLE circle
"parallel or anti-parallel": the REAL equality case, two points
c = i
counterexample: |Phi> = i|Psi> gives equality
and is neither parallel nor anti-parallel
`physics/toesnail.md:105`
"the length of the inner product is always <= 1 and only
exactly equal to one of the vectors are parallel or
anti-parallel"
Over the field the file admitted at l.71, equality holds
exactly when the vectors are linearly DEPENDENT, with a
complex coefficient of modulus one. Both directions are
proved in `lean/Spine.lean`.
The essay adds that this correction and the RAYS concept
are the same content, so it doubles as a demand-driven
on-ramp to rays, costing one sentence.
